name: testnet4-1
summary: Sparrow 2.5.5 and Electrum 4.8.3, one native segwit wallet each, paying each other and a third wallet that only received, following docs/benchmark-wallets.md. A batch (6 or more recipients) or a send-everything of 5 or more coins is marked as such by the person who made it (4 batches, 15 consolidations); every other transaction counts as a payment, including two with 5 or more inputs, one output and no change, where the amount was the payment and the wallet kept its other coins (Sparrow 7080ced38210, 16,837 sat; Electrum 861a83023bea, 10,000 sat). The change of each transaction is the output on its change chain.
